subject: Archaeology
title: The Spanish Armada Wrecks
description: A quick, practical guide to The Spanish Armada Wrecks.

hook.text: In 1588, Spain sent 130 ships to invade England. Storms wrecked dozens along the coasts of Ireland and Scotland.

buildup.text: The English fleet used fire ships and long-range cannons to scatter the Armada into the North Sea.

discovery.text: Divers have found cannons, anchors, gold coins, and personal items from Armada wrecks off the Irish coast.

twist.text: Many sailors who survived the wrecks were killed by locals on shore.

climax.text: The Girona wreck off Northern Ireland yielded a gold salamander pendant and a ruby ring — personal treasures of Spanish.

punchline.text: Spain sent 130 ships. The sea returned jewelry, cannons.

quiz.question: What happened to many Spanish Armada sailors who survived the wrecks?
options: They were welcomed and settled permanently in Ireland
They were killed by locals since Ireland was English territory
They were captured and ransomed back to Spain
